mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and a temperature of 65 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park, accompanied by a lovely waning crescent moon.

The City of Verona remains committed to infrastructure oversight through its long-standing contract with AECOM Inc., which provides consistent engineering reports to the City Council to support our local development.

Today is packed with activities, starting with the Dane County Farmer's Market at the Capitol, followed by live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, don't miss the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena tomorrow.
In a report regarding service calls from last week, an officer conducted a traffic stop on July 31 for a vehicle with no taillights and a flat tire, resulting in the driver being arrested for O W I.
Today's Culver's flavor is the Andes Mint Avalanche. The store is currently closed but will open at 10:00 AM. If you miss out today, tomorrow's flavor will be the Snickers Swirl.
